description_en: Calls DescribeOsVersion to retrieve the details of a specific OS version
description_zh: 调用DescribeOsVersion获取单个系统版本的详细信息
name: DescribeOsVersion

OsVersion.description_en: The basic information about the version

BlackVersionList.description_en: The blacklist of OS versions, separated by commas
BlackVersionList.description_zh: 系统版本黑名单列表，英文逗号隔开

EnableMobileDownload.description_en: Indicates whether upgrade packages can be downloaded over a mobile network
EnableMobileDownload.description_zh: 是否允许移动网络下载升级包

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the version was created, in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 版本创建时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

GmtModify.description_en: The time when the version was created, in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
GmtModify.description_zh: 版本创建时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

IsForceNightUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether a forced night upgrade is enabled. Valid values: Y or N. This value and the forced upgrade option cannot both be set to Y
IsForceNightUpgrade.description_zh: 是否强制夜间升级，Y或N；不允许和是否强制升级同时设置为Y

IsForceUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether a forced upgrade is enabled. Valid values: Y or N

IsMilestone.description_en: Indicates whether this is a milestone version. Valid values: Y or N

MaxClientVersion.description_en: The maximum version code of the OTA SDK that is allowed
MaxClientVersion.description_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最大版本versioncode

MinClientVersion.description_en: The minimum version code of the OTA SDK that is allowed
MinClientVersion.description_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最小版本versioncode

MobileDownloadMaxSize.description_en: The maximum size of packages that can be downloaded over a mobile network, in MB. Packages that exceed this limit are not automatically downloaded even if mobile network download is enabled
MobileDownloadMaxSize.description_zh: 允许移动网络下载的包的最大限制，单位为M，在允许移动网络下载包的情况下，大于该限制的包也不会自动下载

DownloadType.description_en:
The download type for night upgrades. Valid values:

1: download over Wi-Fi only.
2: download over any network
DownloadType.description_zh:
夜间升级下载类型。

1表示WIFI下下载。
2表示任全网下载

IsAllowedCancel.description_en: Indicates whether the night upgrade can be canceled. Valid values: Y or N
IsAllowedCancel.description_zh: 夜间升级是否允许取消，取值：Y或N

IsShowTip.description_en: Indicates whether a prompt is displayed during the night upgrade. Valid values: Y or N
IsShowTip.description_zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，取值：Y或N

ReleaseNote.description_en: The release note of the version
ReleaseNote.example: 改用UI用户体验，提升系统稳定性

Remark.example: 版本备注信息，终端设备不可见

BaseVersion.description_en: The baseline OS version. This value is empty if the package is a full package
BaseVersion.description_zh: 基准系统版本，如果是全量包，则为空

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the upgrade package

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the upgrade package was created, in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 升级包创建时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

GmtModify.description_en: The time when the upgrade package was last modified, in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
GmtModify.description_zh: 升级包修改时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

Md5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the upgrade package

OriginalUrl.description_en: The original URL of the upgrade package

Size.description_en: The size of the upgrade package, in bytes

SplitNum.description_en: The number of shards of the upgrade package. Each shard is 10 MB
SplitNum.description_zh: 升级包分片数，10MB一个分片

VersionId.description_en: The version ID to which the upgrade package belongs

Status.description_en:
The version status. Valid values:

INITIAL: initial state
CREATING: being created
CREATE_FAILED: creation failed
CREATE_COMPLETED: creation completed
TESTING: being tested
TEST_PASSED: test passed
PREPUBLISHED: pre-released
PUBLISHED: published
UNUSED: deprecated
FROZEN: frozen
DOWN: delisted
Status.description_zh:
版本状态，所有的状态有：

INITIAL：初始状态
CREATING：创建中
CREATE_FAILED：创建失败
CREATE_COMPLETED：创建完成
TESTING：测试中
TEST_PASSED：测试已通过
PREPUBLISHED：预发布
PUBLISHED：已发布
UNUSED：已废弃
FROZEN：已冻结
DOWN：已下架

StatusName.description_en: The Chinese name of the version status
